CAP: Capability identifier in the Raisd catalogue (CAP-01 … CAP-55). Same ID on two portals = one capability, two role surfaces.
SDD: Software Design Document — Raisd working-group design baseline under docs/sdd/.
SDD-01: System overview — product intent, portals, constraints.
SDD-02: Architecture and integration — existing CMS backend, Portal API, auth, mobile.
SDD-11: Capability catalogue — exhaustive CAP rows from the checklist.
SDD-14: Existing CMS vs Raisd portals — Cyberjaya inventory mapped to CAP IDs.
SDD-15: Nomenclature — quick links for every CAP-* and M1–M5.
LUCT CMS: Limkokwing University of Creative Technology campus management system (Cyberjaya) — system of record this phase.
ICA: International College Africa / Limkokwing ICA campus lineage — Sierra Leone dump uses EMS PHPMaker desks.
ems_sierraleone: MySQL schema for the ICA Sierra Leone CMS structure dump (23 Sep 2026).
CMS: Campus Management System — operational desks and records for the campus.
Portal API: Integration contract between Raisd portal UIs and the existing CMS (anti-corruption / ACL layer).
SoR: System of Record — authoritative store for operational data (this phase: Cyberjaya / LUCT CMS).
ADR-1: ADR-1: keep existing Cyberjaya CMS as SoR; portals via Portal API; do not duplicate operational desks.
ACL: Anti-corruption layer — Portal API translates portal contracts without cloning CMS tables.
OpenAPI: OpenAPI specification for the Portal API (published Swagger UI).
ERD: Entity-relationship diagram — logical or physical data model view.
DFD: Data-flow diagram — how data moves between actors and systems.
FSD: Functional structure / functional specification of CMS modules.
EMGS: Education Malaysia Global Services — student pass / immigration processing.
eVAL: EMGS electronic valuation / approval step in Student Pass processing.
PDPA: Personal Data Protection Act (Malaysia) — privacy compliance controls.
ICU: Internal Compliance Unit (campus) — PDPA / privacy-adjacent desks.
SP: Stored procedure (MySQL) in the LUCT CMS database.
SPs: Stored procedures (MySQL) in the LUCT CMS database.
k3s: Lightweight Kubernetes distribution planned for portal hosting stages.
SST: Malaysian Sales and Service Tax (finance prototype assumptions).
ADR-2: ADR-2: Singapore, on UltaHost — host on existing VDS estate; size follows launch stage.
ADR-3: ADR-3: Kubernetes starting at the minimum — application workloads on k3s; CMS and mail stay off K8s.
